note: The wall-clock ceiling for the unit suite. MEASURED (never typed), ENFORCED (a blocking CI job), MONOTONIC (the ceiling may only fall). The seed is deliberately loose: it was measured on win32 at 4 workers (534.1 s) and is enforced on ubuntu, so the cross-machine gap is real and is recorded here rather than hidden. The first CI run tightens it with --tighten. testFiles and testCases are RECORDED, not enforced: the file count is a leading indicator of the duration, not a second bar on the same thing.
